title: Supply Shortage

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: I don't have time to chat right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time to chat right now.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Well, you see all these parts scattered around this very vacant floor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you see all these parts scattered around this very vacant floor?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Exactly! There hasn't been a blasted delivery to this floating service station in ages. How do I repair anything with NO PARTS!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly! There hasn't been a blasted delivery to this floating service station in ages. How do I repair anything with NO PARTS!

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: ORS. I mean, I get it, and I'm behind them 100 percent, but the folks in the Spire and the blasted Corpsters who run the supply lines are not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ORS. I mean, I get it, and I'm behind them 100 percent, but the folks in the Spire and the blasted Corpsters who run the supply lines are not.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: What is this your first time on the rig? Everything. Used to be HOVAs and now I'm stuck out here on a two year contract.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is this your first time on the rig? Everything. Used to be HOVAs and now I'm stuck out here on a two year contract.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: I see you've yet to have the pleasure of meeting Finlay Basin. I swear that kid's name needs to be Finally Breaking All of It.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see you've yet to have the pleasure of meeting Finlay Basin. I swear that kid's name needs to be Finally Breaking All of It.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Lured by glitz, glamour, and the all mighty Lim. Just kidding. Kinda. They needed a mechanic and the money was enticing to say the least.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lured by glitz, glamour, and the all mighty Lim. Just kidding. Kinda. They needed a mechanic and the money was enticing to say the least.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Mhm. Makes fixing anything a challenge I don't nor want to try and overcome.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhm. Makes fixing anything a challenge I don't nor want to try and overcome.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: What, outta the goodness of your heart?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What, outta the goodness of your heart?

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Huh. Okay, if you got time to kill and don't wanna see this floating plasteel raft sink into the sea, sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh. Okay, if you got time to kill and don't wanna see this floating plasteel raft sink into the sea, sure.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Don't know whether to respect the hustle or tell yah to swim home. Doesn't change the fact I could use some help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't know whether to respect the hustle or tell yah to swim home. Doesn't change the fact I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Someone needs to talk to Finlay and tell him just... don't fucking touch anything until we get the trade negotiations finished.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone needs to talk to Finlay and tell him just... don't fucking touch anything until we get the trade negotiations finished.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Hahaha... sure. Maybe you'd have better luck gettin' them to reopen the supply lines.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha... sure. Maybe you'd have better luck gettin' them to reopen the supply lines.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: Whoever's in charge of Sea2Sea Shipping. Get 'em to brick the gridlock. You can probably find them in the Industrial District counting their Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoever's in charge of Sea2Sea Shipping. Get 'em to brick the gridlock. You can probably find them in the Industrial District counting their Lims.

nodes.speaker: Botan Noss
nodes.text: One of these day's he's going to blow this life raft into the sky and I don't plan to be here when he does.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One of these day's he's going to blow this life raft into the sky and I don't plan to be here when he does.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why haven't you gotten any deliveries?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why haven't you gotten any deliveries?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why haven't you gotten any deliveries?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why haven't you gotten any deliveries?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything I can do to help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything I can do to help?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything I can do to help?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything I can do to help?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who do I have to talk to?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who do I have to talk to?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who do I have to talk to?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who do I have to talk to?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I look like a teacher?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I look like a teacher?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do I look like a teacher?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do I look like a teacher?
